headline: Quantum Dynamics, Simulation, and Noise Mitigation
summary: Today's research explores structural properties of quantum circuits, advanced simulation and compilation techniques, and noise mitigation in variational algorithms. Additionally, works probe nonclassical foundations and classical simulations of quantum phenomena.

themes.title: Quantum Simulation & Circuit Structure
themes.body: New work addresses optimal query complexity for Lindblad evolution, investigates hidden internal structures in rare outputs of random quantum circuits, and surveys full-stack fault-tolerant compiler design.

themes.title: Noisy Variational Algorithms & Algorithmic Control
themes.body: Researchers examine how hardware noise impacts operator selection in ADAPT-VQE and demonstrate that error mitigation restores convergence, alongside a new software paradigm for adaptive algorithmic control.

themes.title: Foundations & Nonclassicality
themes.body: Studies explore barycentric Rényi divergence additivity, state antidistinguishability in general probabilistic theories, and how classical networks can reproduce quantum statistics and violate the CHSH bound.

connections.body: Both works tackle practical performance improvements in quantum execution, either through runtime mitigation of hardware noise in ADAPT-VQE or through state-proxy equalization in algorithmic control.
